If the italics is part of the original text, write ‘emphasis from original’ in the square brackets following the quotation.

tags.violation_condition: Italic emphasis in a quotation lacks the appropriate square-bracketed provenance label, uses the wrong label for its source, or places the label before rather than after the required text.

when: A quotation contains italic emphasis.
Added emphasis is identified by ‘emphasis added’ in square brackets following the italicised text.
Emphasis retained from the original is identified by ‘emphasis from original’ in square brackets following the quotation.
Determining whether the provenance label is accurate requires access to the original quotation.
rules.why: G-2 keeps added and original emphasis as provenance cases of one annotation check; G-3 does not make adding emphasis obligatory.
